design_thesis: The moment players remember: the Master Pursuer breaks the road and leaves only one lane for three seconds.

sequence.effect: hitstop, camera shake, two lanes crack
only center lane stable; debris falls around it
side lanes return with luminous cracks
audio shifts to shadow tunnel layer

track_event_requirements: lane_mask supports single safe lane windows
debris hazards must leave center readable
camera shake cannot move final collision AABB
no instant kill; one hit max during setpiece unless player ignores all telegraphs

vdp_budget_policy.first_implementation: BG_A crack tiles plus small debris sprites; no giant boss sprite required
vdp_budget_policy.fallback: palette flash, shake and lane mask if crack art is not ready
vdp_budget_policy.blocked: signature setpiece cannot be claimed without runtime capture

audio_plan.single_lane: music drops bass for 1 bar then returns with pressure layer

validation_plan: Only one lane is safe for exactly 180 frames in first spec.
Player can survive without taking damage if centered before impact.
BlastEm capture required before this becomes the official signature moment.
